name: AniWorld Requests
description: Language-aware requests, movie/series destinations and owner-checked download deletion for H0melab Downloader.
overview: Search enabled sources, request the right language, route films and series to separate libraries, and manage your own downloads.
changelog: My Media: own downloads that the downloader marks as moved or changed can now be deleted when Jellyfin holds a file with the same name and exact size; only the video and its own sidecars are removed, re-verified at confirmation. Series posters now come from the matched episode files. New storage indicator shows used and free library space (green, orange, red). Requires Jellyfin 12.4 and H0melab Downloader 2.5.0.
